measurement.comparison_caveat: The performance comparison is between real-MTP builds using the identical unpruned capture4 export and draft limit four. Both full-length coalescing runs regressed and the change was reverted. Do not interpret this as a cross-mode or cross-provider speedup.

compatibility.capacity_zero: GenAI 0.19.0 clamps hybrid MTP drafting to zero.
compatibility.initializer_sharing: Both shared_initializers arrays cleared before loading; empty Config.overlay arrays do not clear them. Original builder config retained. ONNX weights remain self-contained and unchanged.
compatibility.convolution_schema: ORT 1.31.1 accepts six inputs. Removed only the extra seventh state_update_active input from 48 builder convolution nodes; preserved the original ONNX metadata and all GDN active controls.

retained_implementation: Compact convolution/GDN prefix capture. Original capture partition policy, stock MLX affine INT4 GEMV and single-query FP16 attention remain unchanged. The retained library is byte-identical to the measured initial working capture library.

numerical_validation.explanation: Single-token logits for IDs 25 and 593 tie at 25.375. Pure teacher-forced target-only execution in chunks of three or five, without an MTP head or any prefix replay, selects 593 at 25.375 versus 25 at 25.359375. Batching alone crosses this FP16 tie. Therefore no bitwise-equivalence or exact lossless-token claim is made against single-token decoding.
numerical_validation.replay_regressions: Captured and uncaptured GDN kernels preserve output/state bitwise. Real-geometry prefix capsules also reconstruct GPU state bitwise using the GenAI CPU replay's FP32 fma rounding.

rejected_experiments: Padding small affine4 batches to seven rows did not justify forcing stock QMM in synthetic projection microbenchmarks. Multi-query FP16 passed precision checks but showed no demonstrated full-model benefit. Draft-head coalescing measured 5.7011 and 6.4600 tokens/s versus 7.2496 for the retained implementation, so it was reverted too. None of these implementations was retained. Short pilot variance includes large first-decode-interval stalls; no 64-token speedup ratio is presented as qualified evidence.
